reden: Yes. The report’s “[High] ERC20Airdrop2 users can only withdraw full allocation in the single second at window end” describes the same bug: in ERC20Airdrop2.sol, withdraw() guarded by ongoingWithdrawals combined with linear vesting in getBalance() makes 100% available only at claimEnd + withdrawalWindow, but the modifier then immediately disallows withdrawals after that moment (strict < check). As a result, users can’t fully withdraw unless they hit that exact second; otherwise remaining tokens are forever locked. Same contract, same functions (withdraw/getBalance, ongoingWithdrawals), same root cause and impact, and the same fix (relax/adjust the time check) would address both.
